title: feat(kitty-run): adopt the landing's ink catalogue system
Fair jumps + spike walls: unjumpable made intentional
summary: Root-caused the 'unjumpable obstacle' complaint: terrain slope (0.088 max) could eat the 0.5-unit jump margin over tall crates on uphill approaches. Softened the ground waves (WORST_SLOPE pinned in checks) and raised jumpV to 14.2 so worst-case uphill clearance holds with margin. Added the spike wall hazard - deliberately unjumpable (double-jump apex pinned below its top), passable only by dash for +25, gated behind difficulty 0.3 with extra dash-recovery runway and a one-shot teaching banner. Heal pickups slightly more common; new-best badge on game-over card. Fixed vite.config spawnSync EINVAL on modern Node (shell flag for .cmd shims).

title: Brainstorm: mobile feel pass + best-run ghost replay next
summary: User clarified: unjumpable obstacles must never exist (the spike-wall feature was a misread) - removed across the tree and pinned by checks+sim. User picked next: (1) mobile feel pass - haptics, iOS scroll/safe-area hardening; (2) ghost replay of the best run as the signature demo feature. Daily-challenge sharing, game-over stats, onboarding markers considered but not picked.

title: Spikes removed: every obstacle jumpable; distance score + milestone celebrations
summary: Removed the deliberately-unjumpable spike wall mechanic entirely per owner clarification ('unjumpable obstacles shouldn't be present'): spike kind/pattern/constants, dash-through payout, teaching banner + hint HUD/CSS, warn/chime sfx all gone. Checks now pin the positive invariant - a 240-chunk sweep asserts every hazard top stays under the double-jump arc minus worst-case uphill rise (single-jump bar kept for grounded crates). Restored distance scoring (1 pt/m via scoredDistance) so the HUD always breathes. Added 500m milestones: rising chime, two-tone confetti burst, banner via Web Animations API (reduced-motion gets opacity-only fade), meters stat on game-over card. New headless full-run sim (tests/kitty-run.sim.ts): lookahead bot survives 150s/1748m at full hearts; asserts no NaN, only known hazard kinds, milestones exactly once each, seeded whole-run replay determinism.

title: Mobile feel pass + best-run ghost race
summary: Ghost: finished runs stored as seed+timed inputs (lib/replay.ts, sanitized localStorage v1); next runs reuse that seed so a translucent second Kitty simulation replays your best run on the same track (scene/Ghost.tsx, feeder+lockstep stepping in GameLoop, poof on ghost death, ghost chip label). Mobile: stage gesture hardening (touch-action/user-select/tap-highlight), Android haptics on hit/heal/milestone/gameover gated by reduced-motion, AudioContext revive on tab return. startRun zeroes world.time so input logs are run-relative. Verified: 46 node checks + 10 sim checks green, kitty-run tsc clean; repo-wide build blocked only by another agent's in-flight explosion refactor.

title: Visible ghost race + leaner hearts
summary: Ghost rework: handicap launch (TUNING.ghostStartDelay 0.45s, armed on every non-pause transition into running) so a perfect mirror of the best run shows a constant chase gap instead of hiding behind Kitty; ghost also skips player hit-stop now (true lockstep). Rendering: depthWrite back ON plus one spectral blue-violet remap of every rig colour and a pulsing softDot glow quad - no more x-ray stacking of translucent ellipses, reads as a spirit at a glance. HUD chip is live: +/- metres gap, warming up, out. Difficulty: heartArc weight 1.6->0.85 and 4->3 hearts per arc, heal gated 0.15->0.3 at weight 0.8, starLine 1.15, shorter rests, heavier hazard weights, speedRamp 520->420, DIFFICULTY_SPAN 800->650. Verified: 46 node checks + 10 sim checks green, bot still survives 150s/1811m at full hearts on 4 seeds, tsc clean, vite build clean.

title: Browser-verified ghost race; fixed two launch bugs it exposed
summary: Headless Edge + playwright-core screenshot session against the built bundle (localStorage seeded with a replay). Exposed and fixed: (1) startRun zeroed time but not distance, so the ready-screen idle drift gifted an unclosable player lead that pushed the ghost permanently offscreen - runs now always begin at metre zero; (2) the launch gate armed via a status-transition ref but the ghost-swap effect reset it to Infinity - an effect-order race left the ghost warming up forever; replaced with a self-contained warmup accumulator reset by the ghost effect itself, accumulated with the sim dt cap so the handicap stays exact on slow frames. Evidence: desktop shots show the spectral ghost racing 3-4m behind with live chip gap; portrait framing holds; ghost self-occludes cleanly with glow. Chip restyled into the spectral violet family. Verified: tsc, 46 checks, 10 sim checks, vite build all green; screenshots in temp opencode dir.

title: Neutral echo rename + always-on-screen chase
summary: Renamed the best-run ghost feature to the neutral 'echo' across UI chip, CSS class, component (Ghost.tsx -> Echo.tsx), props/refs, comments, README and check strings; localStorage key kitty-run.replay.v1 deliberately unchanged so visitors keep saved bests. Root-caused the mobile off-display complaint: a 0.45s time handicap stretches with speed (3.2 -> 6.3 m), but portrait stages show only ~2.7 units behind Kitty. Replaced the fragile warmup accumulator with a distance gate (TUNING.echoGapMetres 2): the echo launches once the player opens that lead, then both sims share speed so the gap freezes instead of growing; kills the n13 effect-order bug class outright. Added stageSpan/clampInto/STAGE_*_MARGIN to framing.ts (same linear model floaters use) and the Echo draw now clamps into the visible band, so even a big late-run lead pins her to the edge instead of losing her; death poof uses the same clamp. New checks pin the distance-handicap shape and that the clamped echo keeps daylight from the player from 9/19.5 portrait to 3.2 ultrawide. Browser-verified against the built bundle (seeded replay, headless Edge): chip reads echo gap live, gap breathes -2..-1 as the recorded dash fires (honest race dynamics); mobile 390px and desktop 1440px shots show the spectral echo on stage for the whole probe. Verified: checks, sim, tsc, vite build all green.

title: Echo narrative on the menu cards
summary: The signature race feature was invisible to a first-time visitor until the run began. Ready card now wears a quiet violet pill 'your best run will chase you' (new .kitty-run-card-echo class, same colour family as the in-run chip - deliberately not the loud new-best badge). Over card compares the run against the mark that was on the line: raceTarget state freezes the raced replay at start (autostart included), so the card reads 'N m past/short of your best mark' even when this run just rewrote the replay; distance-mark vs score-best stay distinct wordings since they are different axes. Verified: tsc, vite build, checks+sim green; headless Edge shots at 390px show the teaser on ready and '574 m short of your best mark' on over.

title: Framing pull-back + chalk-white solid echo + contact shadow
summary: Visitor-reported fixes, browser-verified. (1) Camera pulled back: BASE_CAM_Z 11.5->16, FOV 38->34 (single BASE_FOV export shared by RunCanvas), LEAD_MAX 2.4->3.2. (2) Echo see-through root-caused: translucent materials with depthWrite rely on three's distance sort across hundredths-of-a-unit offsets; dress drew after head fill and shone through it. Fix: pinPainterOrder sorts echo meshes by world z once at mount and assigns explicit renderOrder (base 10 keeps the subtree behind default transparents). (3) Echo recolored from blue-violet to a near-white spectral family (opacity 0.72), glow softened; README wording updated. (4) Race gap widened: TUNING.echoGapMetres 2->6 so she visibly trails on desktop; new proximity fade thins her to 0.22 opacity when the phone stage clamp seats her next to the player. (5) New Shadow.tsx: soft ellipse riding groundY() under Kitty, tightening/fading with jump height. (6) New tests/kitty-run.shots.mjs puppeteer probe: boots vite via node directly (Windows refuses .cmd spawns; vite binds ::1, not 127.0.0.1), seeds a stored replay so the echo is on stage, captures desktop+mobile shots, fails on page/console errors (headless vibrate block whitelisted). Verified: checks, sim, tsc, vite build green; desktop 1440x810 + mobile 390x844 screenshots reviewed.

title: Ready screen becomes a shop window
summary: The ready overlay was a dark scrim that hid the game behind a dark box — a flat first impression for portfolio visitors. Now: light pastel wash (rgba(255,243,248,.34), blur 2px) so Kitty idles in full view; the card is paper-white with ink text, bow-red start button, violet-on-light echo pill, soft violet shadow and a gentle float (gated behind prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference); the card parks in the run-ahead space via place-items center end + 11% right padding, leaving Kitty's idle pose unobstructed on the left; small screens recenter the card (no room beside her). Pause/over keep the dark focus treatment. Probe extended with a desktop-menu shot (seed-after-reload pattern for localStorage). Verified: shots desktop/mobile/menu reviewed, tsc + checks + sim + vite build green.
